svg.title: Metric ellipses of the diffusion spacetime
svg.desc: A grid of ellipses over the toy spacetime, each the set of steps of Fisher-Rao length 0.3. At small t they are tiny dots; they grow with t, elongate along x_t, and past t of about 0.7 exceed their cells, showing that moving x_t at high noise is almost free.
svg.text: Equal-cost ellipses of the Fisher–Rao metric, √(dzᵀG dz) = 0.3, on the toy spacetime
Solid: the whole ellipse fits in its cell. Dashed: clipped to the cell, so moving there is even cheaper than drawn.
Near t = 0 the ellipses shrink to dots (posteriors nearly Dirac); near t = 1 every direction is cheap (memorylessness, Eq 11).
